agent_assessment: Substantial refactoring was completed: 127 files changed (~21.5K insertions, ~20.3K deletions) in commit 14ee36b60b. Phase 1 (golangci-lint config) is complete — .golangci.yml created with gocyclo threshold 15, and both API and CLI modules pass lint cleanly. Runtime has 7 lint issues (5 gocyclo in test files, 1 gocritic in main.go, 1 gocyclo in deps test). Phase 2 (file splitting) achieved major reductions: all originally-identified 1000+ line files were split well below thresholds (e.g., orchestrator_test.go 1506→262, service_test.go 2433→558, commands.go 1581→295). However, 4 non-generated Go/TS files remain above the 700-line mandatory threshold: errors_constructors.go (734, a new split product), errors.go (706), build/service.go (739, not in original plan scope), and useGeneratorFormState.ts (738, a new extraction). Phase 3 (complexity reduction) was partially addressed via file splitting and function extraction. The plan's funlen linter was omitted from the config. Testing shows a critical issue: the pipeline package has 10 consistently failing tests (TestStageFailure, TestResumePipeline, TestStopAfterStage, etc.). These tests existed in the pre-refactor orchestrator_test.go, and the failures appear to be timing/race conditions in async orchestrator assertions — likely pre-existing flaky tests exposed by the split, not newly introduced bugs. CLI and runtime tests all pass. Other intermittent API failures (health, generation, livedesktop) appeared on one run but not the next, confirming flakiness rather than regression.

improvement_suggestions.description: Fix the 10 pipeline orchestrator test failures — these are timing-dependent async tests checking pipeline status too early. Add proper synchronization (waitForStatus helper or poll loop) instead of immediate assertions after RunPipeline returns.

Add funlen linter to .golangci.yml (was in plan but omitted). Set max-lines ~500 to auto-enforce the file length constraint going forward, catching files like errors_constructors.go (734) and build/service.go (739).
Exclude test files (_test.go) from gocyclo in .golangci.yml — table-driven tests naturally have high cyclomatic complexity. This would eliminate 6 of 7 runtime lint violations.
Split errors_constructors.go (734 lines) further — it was created by the errors.go split but still exceeds the 700-line threshold. Similarly split useGeneratorFormState.ts (738 lines).
Fix gocritic exitAfterDefer in runtime/cmd/runtime/main.go:69 — log.Fatalf prevents defer cancel() from running. Use log.Printf + os.Exit(1) or restructure the error handling.
